# Live Virtual Guide

> > Small-group walking tours of Rome featuring historic neighborhoods, underground sites, and local experiences in Trastevere, the Jewish Ghetto, and the historic center.

Live Virtual Guide specializes in intimate walking tours of Rome with a maximum of 12 participants, exploring hidden gems like underground Piazza Navona, the Temple of Hadrian, and authentic neighborhoods. Tours emphasize local culture, Caravaggio's masterpieces, street food experiences, and ancient Rome's lesser-known archaeological sites.

## Key Topics

- Rome walking tours
- Small-group tours (max 12 people)
- Trastevere neighborhood
- Jewish Ghetto
- Piazza Navona
- Underground tours
- Temple of Hadrian
- Tiber Island
- Trevi Fountain
- Caravaggio artworks
- Historic center tours
- Hidden gems and local experiences
- Street food tours
- Semi-private tours
- Ancient Rome archaeology
